text: 砂で滑りますね
translation: It's slippery because of the sand.

text: 敵の反応が近づきました / 気をつけましょう
translation: Enemy reactions are approaching. / Let's be careful.

vocabulary.meaning: to be careful, to pay attention

text: 機械生命体が言葉
translation: The machine lifeforms are speaking words...
grammar: Sentence appears incomplete/interrupted

text: こういう個体も増えたってレジスタンスの人が言ってましたね / どうして最近になって増えたんだろう
translation: The resistance members said these types of individuals have been increasing. / I wonder why they've been increasing recently.
grammar: って is casual quotation marker; んだろう expresses wondering

text: アンドロイド / 敵 / アンドジョン
translation: Android / Enemy / Andjon
grammar: Machine lifeform attempting to speak; アンドジョン appears to be corrupted/incomplete speech

text: 怖い / 怖い / 敵
translation: Scary / Scary / Enemy

text: 機械生命体にも / 怖いっていう感情があるんでしょうか
translation: Do machine lifeforms also have emotions like fear?
grammar: って is casual quotation; んでしょうか expresses wondering/asking for confirmation

text: 敵 / 敵
translation: Enemy / Enemy

text: 殺す / どうして / いや
translation: Kill / Why / No

text: 怖い / 何で余計なものを見つけてる
translation: Scary / Why are they finding unnecessary things?
grammar: てる is casual contraction of ている

text: 昔人間が着ていたものに感じが似ていますね
translation: It feels similar to what humans used to wear long ago.

text: データで見たことがある / そういえば顔のペイントも
translation: I've seen it in the data. / Come to think of it, the face paint too...

vocabulary.meaning: come to think of it, now that you mention it

grammar: ことがある = have experience of doing something

text: 共同体特有の化粧みたいだ
translation: It looks like makeup unique to a community.
grammar: みたいだ = seems like, looks like

text: 嫌だよ、怖い、よ、け、て、助けて
translation: I don't want to, scary, s-stay back, help me
grammar: Machine lifeform speech is broken/stuttering

text: トゥービー、奴らの言葉に意味はありません / ランダムで単語を発生しているだけです / だいたい、助けてって言いながら攻撃するなんて矛盾してるし / そうだね
translation: 2B, their words have no meaning. / They're just randomly generating words. / Besides, saying 'help me' while attacking is contradictory. / You're right.
grammar: って is casual quotation; なんて emphasizes the absurdity; してるし = and furthermore

text: 逃げる逃げる / 怖い
translation: Run away, run away / Scary

text: あっちの岩場に逃げましたよ / ターゲット個体識別信号をマーク
translation: It escaped to those rocks over there. / Marking the target individual identification signal.

text: あれは? / 怪盗 / 人類の住居だったエリアの廃墟 / 鉄骨とコンクリートでできた高層建築に大勢で居住し / マンモス団地などと呼ばれていた
translation: What's that? / Query / Ruins of an area that used to be human residences / Many people lived in high-rise buildings made of steel frames and concrete / They were called mammoth housing complexes.

vocabulary.meaning: query (likely meant to be クエリ but mispronounced/misread)

grammar: だった = past tense of だ; などと = things like

text: お前たち、人
translation: You guys, people...
grammar: Incomplete/broken speech from machine lifeform

text: 入れろ 入れろ
translation: Let us in, let us in

vocabulary.meaning: to let in, to put in

grammar: ろ is command form

text: ターゲットを指認しました 追いかけましょう
translation: Target visually confirmed. Let's pursue.

text: こんにちは / こんにちは いいで
translation: Hello / Hello, good...
grammar: Machine lifeforms attempting greetings; speech cuts off

text: お疲れ様でした
translation: Good work (thank you for your efforts).

vocabulary.meaning: thank you for your hard work, good job

grammar: Polite phrase typically said after completing work; ironic when said by enemy machines

text: 残して、残して、やめて!
translation: Leave me behind, leave me behind, stop!
grammar: て form is used for commands/requests

text: 皆、死んだ! / お前達は、犠牲者、犬が、お前と!
translation: Everyone died! / You are... victims... dogs... you!
grammar: Broken/incoherent speech from machine lifeform

text: 逃げろ逃げろ
translation: Run, run
grammar: ろ is command form

text: あ、間違えた
translation: Ah, I made a mistake.

vocabulary.meaning: to make a mistake, to be wrong

text: どういう基準で言葉を選んでるんだろう
translation: I wonder what criteria they're using to choose their words.
grammar: てる is casual contraction of ている; んだろう expresses wondering

text: アンドロイドたちの死体 / 推測
translation: Android corpses. / Conjecture:

text: 当地域に生息する機械生命体によるもの / なんでこんな場所に
translation: Caused by machine lifeforms inhabiting this area. / Why in a place like this?

vocabulary.meaning: this area, the area in question

grammar: によるもの = thing caused by; こんな = like this

text: 理由 / まるであそこに逃げ込んでます
translation: Reason: / It's as if they fled into there.

vocabulary.meaning: to flee into, to take refuge in

grammar: まるで~ます = as if (usually followed by ような but can stand alone)

text: しつこい逃げる逃げる逃げなきゃ
translation: Persistent! Run, run, gotta run
grammar: なきゃ is contraction of なければ (must, have to)

text: この先に多数の機械生命体反応を確認
translation: Confirming numerous machine lifeform reactions ahead.

text: でもこのアンドロイドの死体は一体 / 注意して進もう
translation: But what about these android corpses... / Let's proceed carefully.
grammar: 一体 adds emphasis to questions; して = doing/while doing

text: 子供 / 子供 / 子供
translation: Child / Child / Child

text: なんだこれは / 大好き
translation: What is this? / Love you

text: 大好き / 耳を貸しちゃダメです
translation: Love you / Don't listen to them.

vocabulary.meaning: to lend an ear, to listen to

grammar: ちゃ is contraction ofては; ちゃダメ = must not

text: 一緒にいよう / 一緒にいよう / 抱っこ、抱っこ
translation: Let's be together / Let's be together / Hold me, hold me

vocabulary.meaning: holding (a child), carrying in one's arms

grammar: よう is volitional form (let's)

text: こいつらに心なんかない / ただ、人間の言葉を真似しているだけだよ
translation: These things don't have hearts. / They're just imitating human words.
grammar: なんか emphasizes negation; だけだ = only, just

text: 破壊しましょう
translation: Let's destroy them.

text: お、あ、あ、あ、あ、あ、あ、あ、あ、あ、あ、あ、あ、あ、あ、あ、あ、あ、あ
translation: [Screaming sounds]
grammar: Vocalizations/screaming from machine lifeforms

text: 殺す、殺す、壊す / 愛してる、殺す / 裏に、つらに、ぶち壊す
translation: Kill, kill, destroy / Love you, kill / Behind, destroy, smash to pieces
grammar: てる is contraction of ている

text: このままじゃ、ダメ
translation: We can't continue like this.

text: このままじゃ、ダメ
translation: We can't continue like this.

text: このままじゃ、ダメ
translation: We can't continue like this.

text: 一体これは
translation: What on earth is this?
grammar: 一体 adds emphasis to questions

text: アンドロイド? / 違う! / こいつ…
translation: An android? / No! / This thing...

text: 機械生命体です!
translation: It's a machine lifeform!

text: ああ… / ああ…
translation: Ahh... / Ahh...
grammar: Vocalizations expressing pain/distress

text: アンド… / アンドロイド… / どうして…
translation: Andr... / Android... / Why...
grammar: Broken speech indicating damage/malfunction

text: 戦うか…
translation: So you fight...
grammar: か is question particle expressing reflection/confirmation

text: 刀 / 避ける弾
translation: Sword / Dodging bullets
grammar: Fragmented observations during combat

text: 火事 / あいつ進化してる
translation: Fire / That thing is evolving.
grammar: てる is contraction of ている

text: 一気に蹴りをつけましょう
translation: Let's finish this in one go.

vocabulary.meaning: to settle, to bring to an end

grammar: 蹴りをつける is an idiom meaning to settle/conclude something

text: 次回予告
translation: Next episode preview

text: これが機械生命体
translation: This is a machine lifeform.

text: もう一体増えるなんて
translation: To think another one would appear...
grammar: なんて expresses surprise or disbelief

text: ドゥビー 脱出しないと
translation: 2B, we have to escape.
grammar: しないと is contraction of しないといけない (must do)

text: ドゥビー あの横穴から逃げられそうです
translation: 2B, it looks like we can escape through that side passage.
grammar: られる is potential form (can do); そう = seems like, looks like

text: ДИНАМИЧНАЯ МУЗЫКА
translation: [Dynamic music]
grammar: This is Russian Cyrillic text (ДИНАМИЧНАЯ МУЗЫКА = Dynamic Music) - likely a subtitle/caption error

text: 止まった / ここまで来たら大丈夫そうですね
translation: It stopped. / It looks like we're safe once we're here.
grammar: たら = once, when; そう = seems like

text: 一体あの機械生命体は / これまでに見たことのないタイプでした
translation: What was that machine lifeform? / It was a type we've never seen before.
grammar: ことのない = have never done; の modifies タイプ

text: 後で司令部に報告しましょう
translation: Let's report to command later.

text: 司令部に連絡するために / 通信状況の良いエリアに移動しましょう
translation: In order to contact command, / let's move to an area with good communication conditions.
grammar: ために = in order to, for the purpose of

text: 司令部との通信できるようになりました
translation: We can now communicate with command.

vocabulary.meaning: can do, to be able to

grammar: ようになる = to become able to, to reach a state where

text: 9Sからバーカーへ応答をお願いします / オペレーターより9S受信しました / 先ほど人型
translation: 9S to Bunker, requesting response. / Operator to 9S, received. / A short while ago, humanoid...
grammar: より = from; sentence appears to cut off

text: つまりアンドロイドに似た質感を持つ機械生命体と遭遇しました / 残念ながら取り逃しましたが
translation: In other words, we encountered a machine lifeform with an android-like texture. / Unfortunately, we let it escape, but...

vocabulary.meaning: in other words, that is to say
to let escape, to miss capturing

text: その時の光線データを転送させてもらいます / 了解しました
translation: I'll have the optical data from that time transferred. / Understood.

vocabulary.meaning: light beam, optical (likely means 映像 video/visual data in context)

grammar: させてもらう = to have permission to do, to be allowed to do

text: 転送を開始します / それじゃあ分析の方よろしくお願いしますね
translation: Beginning transfer. / Well then, please take care of the analysis.

vocabulary.word: よろしくお願いします
vocabulary.reading: よろしくおねがいします
vocabulary.meaning: please take care of it (polite request)

grammar: 方 here is used to soften the request

text: ふぅ / これで一段落しましたね
translation: Phew. / That settles things for now.

vocabulary.meaning: a pause, a break, completion of a stage

text: トゥビー / ここからの作戦行動について相談があるんですが / さっきの機械生命体との戦闘で受けたダメージが心配です
translation: 2B, / I have something to discuss about our operational activities from here. / I'm worried about the damage we took in the battle with that machine lifeform earlier.
grammar: んです is explanatory tone; が at end softens the statement

text: 一度レジスタンスキャンプに戻って補給やメンテナンスをしますか
translation: Should we return to the resistance camp once to resupply and do maintenance?
grammar: て connects actions; や lists examples

text: いやこのまま継続して機械生命体を排除しよう
translation: No, let's continue as we are and eliminate machine lifeforms.
grammar: して connects actions; よう is volitional form (let's)

text: 了解です / あまり無理しないでくださいね
translation: Understood. / Please don't push yourself too hard.

vocabulary.meaning: to overdo it, to push oneself

grammar: しないで = don't do; ね adds friendly emphasis

text: オペレーターより9S / 先ほどのデータの転送が完了しました / 了解です / 別件ですが司令官から2B9S両名へのメッセージがあります / 再生します
translation: Operator to 9S. / The data transfer from earlier has been completed. / Understood. / On a separate matter, there's a message from the commander for both 2B and 9S. / Playing it now.
grammar: への = to/for (indicating direction)

text: 地上に向かっているヨルハ部隊の数機が連絡を絶った
translation: Several YoRHa units heading to the surface have lost contact.
grammar: ている indicates ongoing state; 連絡を絶つ = to lose contact

text: 現在もブラックボックス信号が確認されていることから
translation: Since black box signals are still being confirmed even now,
grammar: されている = passive continuous; ことから = since, because

text: 死亡は指定いないと推定される / 信号の発信されているポイントを絞り込んだので
translation: Death is presumed unlikely. / Since we've narrowed down the points where signals are being transmitted,

vocabulary.meaning: designation (likely meant to be していない - not occurring)

grammar: される = passive; されている = passive continuous; ので = so, since

text: 地上に滞在中のヨルハ部隊員には本件の調査を命ずる
translation: YoRHa personnel currently on the surface are ordered to investigate this matter.
grammar: には = to/for (with emphasis); を命ずる = to order something

text: 以上で通信を終了します / そういえばレジスタンスキャンプでも同じような話を聞いた
translation: This concludes the transmission. / Come to think of it, I heard a similar story at the resistance camp too.

vocabulary.meaning: come to think of it, now that you mention it

grammar: で marks location; でも = also, even at

text: 目標地点の情報をセットしました / 他のアンドロイドの人たちが心配ですね / 早めに行った方がいい気がします
translation: Target location information has been set. / I'm worried about the other androids. / I feel like we should go sooner rather than later.

vocabulary.meaning: to feel like, to have a feeling that

grammar: 方がいい = should, it's better to; 気がする = I feel like

text: 地上からのルートは封鎖されているみたいですね
translation: It looks like the route from the surface is blocked.
grammar: されている = passive continuous; みたい = seems like, appears to be

text: 地下から行けないか調べてみましょう
translation: Let's investigate whether we can go from underground.
grammar: 行けないか = whether can go (negative question); てみる = try doing

text: ねぇ、トゥビー、砂漠にいた機械生命体、見た目は完全にアンドロイドと同じでしたね。
translation: Hey, 2B, that machine lifeform in the desert - its appearance was completely identical to an android.

text: 確かに。 / 僕らアンドロイドは、想像したる人間の姿を模して作られてるけど、
translation: That's true. / We androids are made to imitate the form of our revered human creators, but...
grammar: して = doing; られてる = passive contraction of られている; けど = but

text: 機械生命体は、どうして僕らの姿を真似するんでしょうか?
translation: Why do machine lifeforms imitate our form?
grammar: んでしょうか = I wonder, do you think (question with uncertainty)

text: 考えても分からないことに時間を割くのは無駄。 / そうですね。
translation: It's pointless to spend time on things we can't understand even if we think about them. / You're right.
grammar: ても = even if; のは = the act of (nominalizer); に時間を割く = to devote time to
